正常打字的单字符键（字母 / 数字 / 标点）不显示，只在组合键与功能键时出现，: Hide single-character keys (letters / digits / punctuation) typed on their own; show them only in combinations or for function keys, to avoid flooding the screen
打开后每次物理按键都会浮一条「组合键 + ↓（按下）/ ↑（抬起）」。它只是看板: Once enabled, every physical key press shows a “combination + ↓ (down) / ↑ (up)” overlay. It is display-only: click-through, never focuses, and never triggers an input-state reset on foreground changes.
暂停快捷键、全屏程序自动暂停、全局排除程序命中时都不显示；Kada 自己注入的按: Hidden while shortcuts are paused, while a fullscreen app pauses input, and in globally excluded apps. Keys injected by Kada are never echoed.
绝对屏幕坐标，主屏左上角为 (0,0)，多屏可为负: Absolute screen coordinates; the primary display's top-left is (0,0), and values can be negative on multi-monitor setups
移动到本次手势的起点（仅手势触发可用）: Move to the origin of this gesture (only available for gesture triggers)
双击 Ctrl+C 弹出菜单: Open a menu on double Ctrl+C
选中文字后连按两次 Ctrl+C，在光标处弹出动作菜单；复制本身照常进行（不吞键: Select text and press Ctrl+C twice to open an action menu at the cursor. Copying still happens as usual (keys are never swallowed). Hidden while paused, fullscreen-paused, or in an excluded app.
两次 Ctrl+C 的最大间隔（毫秒，150~2000）；调大更容易触发，也更容: Maximum gap between the two Ctrl+C presses in milliseconds (150–2000); larger is easier to trigger but also easier to fire by accident
每个条目是一个动作：可以是「粘贴为纯文本」「用搜索引擎搜选中文字」「转大写」「复: Each entry is one action, e.g. “paste as plain text”, “search the selected text”, “uppercase”, or “copy to a file”. For multiple steps choose “Action group” and chain the actions. Submenus can nest two more levels; separators are purely visual grouping.
弹菜单时剪贴板里已经有复制好的文字：动作里可以用「剪贴板 → 读取到变量」拿它，: When the menu opens the copied text is already on the clipboard: use “Clipboard → Read into variable” to take it, or the {clipboard} placeholder (available in command / text actions). Unchecking an entry greys it out but keeps it in the config.
还没有条目：点下面的「＋ 动作」开始添加。: No entries yet: click “+ Action” below to add one.
取消勾选 = 菜单里灰掉不可点（配置保留）: Uncheck to grey it out in the menu (kept in the config)
目标窗口：进程名或标题关键字，如 chrome.exe / 记事本: Target window: process name or title keyword, e.g. chrome.exe / Notepad
把按键或文本发给一个非前台窗口，全程不激活、不抢焦点。目标填进程名或窗口标题关键: Sends keys or text to a non-foreground window without activating or focusing it. The target matches a process name or window-title keyword (case-insensitive, * and ? supported); the topmost match wins. Windows only; browsers / Electron / UWP / games / elevated windows usually ignore these messages, and it never falls back to foreground injection.
仅 Windows 支持：在资源管理器里打开所在文件夹并选中它。: Windows only: opens the containing folder in Explorer and selects it.
永久清空回收站，不弹系统确认。仅 Windows 支持；其它平台会标平台冲突并在: Permanently empties the recycle bin without a system confirmation. Windows only; other platforms show a platform conflict and fail at runtime.
立刻关闭显示器；动一下鼠标或按任意键就会亮回来。仅 Windows 支持。: Turns the display off immediately; moving the mouse or pressing a key turns it back on. Windows only.
显示 / 隐藏桌面图标（等价于右键桌面 → 查看 → 显示桌面图标）。仅 Win: Shows / hides desktop icons (same as right-clicking the desktop → View → Show desktop icons). Windows only.
结果存进该变量，后续动作用 {result} 引用。变量与「直接注入」至少填一项: Stores the result in this variable; later actions can reference {result}. Fill in a variable or enable direct injection.
直接注入结果到当前焦点: Inject the result into the focused control
base64 解码会忽略换行与空白；解码结果必须是 UTF-8 文本。非法输入（: Base64 decoding ignores line breaks and whitespace; the decoded bytes must be UTF-8 text. Invalid input (bad base64, incomplete %XX) fails loudly instead of silently dropping content.
v1 只存 PNG；没写扩展名会自动补 .png。路径支持 {变量}。: v1 saves PNG only; .png is appended when the extension is missing. The path supports {variable} placeholders.
按下触发键后整块屏幕会冻结，拖拽框选；按 Esc 或右键取消（不算失败）。: The whole screen freezes so you can drag a selection; press Esc or right-click to cancel (not treated as a failure).
目前仅 Windows 支持（GDI）；贴图是临时浮窗，拖拽移动、右键关闭，重启: Windows only (GDI). A pinned image is a temporary window: drag to move, right-click to close, and it is not restored after restart.
只调主显示器（DDC/CI，VCP 0x10）。「恢复」用本次运行第一次调节前缓: Adjusts the primary monitor only (DDC/CI, VCP 0x10). “Restore” uses the original brightness cached before the first adjustment in this run; unsupported monitors fail loudly. Windows only.
作用对象是触发那一刻的前台窗口，不会激活或切换窗口，也不按程序名匹配。目前仅 W: Acts on the foreground window at the moment of the trigger; it does not activate or switch windows and does not match by program name. Windows only for now; other platforms report a platform conflict and fail at execution.
多段用逗号分隔：D,R = 先下再右（两段），DR = 右下斜向（一段），两者是: Separate multiple segments with commas: D,R = down then right (two segments), DR = a single down-right diagonal — they are two different gestures. Consecutive repeats collapse automatically (D,D,R becomes D,R). Patterns also accept UP / ↓ and similar spellings and are normalized on save.
没匹配上手势时右键照常弹菜单（被吞掉的右键会补回来），只是会晚十几毫秒。手势开着: When no gesture matches, the right-click menu still appears (the swallowed click is replayed), just a few milliseconds later. While gestures are on, the right button belongs to gestures: mouse recording cannot capture it, and a right click is slightly delayed.
方向串：DR = 右下斜向，D,R = 先下再右（多段用逗号）: Direction pattern: DR = down-right diagonal, D,R = down then right (comma separates segments)
按住鼠标左键在画板上画，松开后自动转成方向串；可重画后再确认。: Hold the left mouse button and draw on the pad; release to convert it into a direction pattern. Redraw before confirming if needed.
没画出方向：再画长一点: No direction detected: draw a bit longer
截图动作已移除（执行会报错）：现在改用鼠标手势——按住右键绕一圈，右键别松再点一: The screenshot action has been removed (it now fails). Use the mouse gesture instead: hold the right button and draw a loop, then left-click while still holding it to confirm.
外部工具能力目前只做「探测到在跑就出现在动作里」：执行会明确报「尚未接入」，不会: External tool capabilities are detection-only for now: they appear when the tool is running, and execution fails loudly with “not connected” instead of calling it.
按住右键绕一圈，右键别松再点一下左键确认，包围盒裁图写进剪贴板（Snipaste: Hold the right button and draw a loop, then left-click while still holding it to confirm; the bounding box goes to the clipboard (Snipaste pastes it automatically if running). Drawing a loop alone does not capture. No gesture entry needed. Windows only for now.
录一段按键（组合键与按键间隔），录完替换当前动作: Record a key sequence (combos and gaps); it replaces this step when done
用电脑里设置了关联的默认程序打开这个文件（按扩展名，如 .pdf 用 PDF 阅: Open this file with the app associated in the OS (by extension, e.g. .pdf in a PDF reader, .docx in Word).
用系统默认浏览器打开该网页。没写协议头的会自动补 https://。: Open this URL in the system default browser. https:// is added automatically when the scheme is missing.
网址，如 example.com（不写 https:// 也行；支持 {变量名}: URL, e.g. example.com (https:// optional; {变量名} placeholders supported)
⚠ 已配置 {0} 条鼠标手势，但「鼠标操作」未开启 → 不会触发: ⚠ {0} mouse gestures configured, but “Mouse actions” is off → they will not trigger
默认关闭；关掉后鼠标手势 / 右键圈选截图 / 触发角 / 边缘滚动一律不可用（: Off by default. When disabled, mouse gestures / right-drag lasso screenshot / hot corners / edge scrolling are all unavailable (hidden and inactive); their configuration is kept.
总开关打开后到「快捷键」页新增条目：模式下拉里可选「鼠标操作」（按住右键画轨迹，: After enabling the master switch, add entries on the “Shortcuts” page: the mode menu offers “Mouse gesture” (hold the right button and draw a path, matched by direction pattern), “Hot corner” (cursor touches a screen corner), and “Edge scrolling” (scroll the wheel while the cursor is against a screen edge). The hot corner / edge scrolling editors show a mock monitor; click the corner or edge you want, then configure actions below.
鼠标手势的方向串用 U 上 / D 下 / L 左 / R 右，斜向写两个字母如: Mouse gesture patterns use U up / D down / L left / R right; diagonals use two letters such as UR for up-right. Separate segments with commas: D,R = down then right (two segments), DR = a single down-right diagonal.
全屏程序（游戏 / 视频 / F11）和上图排除列表里的程序里一律让路：手势不接: Full-screen apps (games / video / F11) and apps in the exclusion list above are left alone: gestures do not take over the right button, and hot corners / edge scrolling do not trigger.
右键圈选截图依赖 Snipaste：裁剪图会先写进剪贴板；Snipaste 在跑: The right-drag lasso screenshot depends on Snipaste: the cropped image is written to the clipboard first; if Snipaste is running, F3 pastes it as a floating image, and annotation / saving / pinning happen in Snipaste. Without Snipaste running there is only the clipboard image — paste it yourself.
当前位置：{0}；同一位置可建多条，按列表顺序取第一条启用的。: Current spot: {0}. Multiple entries are allowed for the same spot; the first enabled one in list order wins.
